status_note: Reproduces on 2.0.0 and 2.0.1 (the pinned release) with the `iceberg` extension from DuckDB's repository. No issue in duckdb/duckdb or duckdb/duckdb-iceberg names it (searched 2026-11-22). The extension's own version was not checked against its main.
title: iceberg_scan fails with "Invalid Avro file block count or size" on a table whose snapshot has no manifests
summary: `iceberg_scan` on the metadata of an Iceberg table that was overwritten with no rows raises `Invalid Input Error: Invalid Avro file block count or size`. The table's snapshot has a manifest list with no entries, which is valid Avro (fastavro reads it as an empty list) and which pyiceberg scans as 0 rows. DuckDB's reader takes the file with no data blocks as corrupt.
A table emptied by a delete that leaves a position-delete file reads as an empty result; the failure needs a snapshot with no manifests at all.
repro: `t = catalog.create_table('db.t', schema=pa.schema([('id', pa.int64())])); t.append(pa.table({'id': [1]})); t.overwrite(pa.table({'id': pa.array([], pa.int64())}))`, then `INSTALL iceberg; LOAD iceberg; SELECT * FROM iceberg_scan('<t.metadata_location>')` (pyiceberg 0.10 with a SQLite catalog, DuckDB 2.0.1): the error. The same call before the overwrite returns `(1,)`.
handling: None in sverify: it reads Iceberg with pyiceberg. The test of the quarantine table's readers (`python/tests/test_io_sink_readers.py`) reads an emptied quarantine table with pyiceberg only and says why.
found_by: #2423: DuckDB's iceberg_scan as an outside reader of the quarantine table

checked.note: repro run on the pinned release, with fastavro reading the manifest list; the extension's main not checked
